# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
# Audit FP pattern: test module with fixed/hardcoded argv (literal flavour + temp path).
lang: python
file: tests/test_compliance.py
---
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

VERAPDF_BIN = "verapdf"


def _assert_verapdf_compliant(fixture_name: str, data: bytes, tmp: str) -> None:
    path = Path(tmp) / (fixture_name + ".pdf")
    path.write_bytes(data)
    result = subprocess.run(
        [VERAPDF_BIN, "-f", "4", str(path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0


def test_note_flavours(tmp: str, data: bytes) -> None:
    path = Path(tmp) / "note.pdf"
    path.write_bytes(data)
    for flavour in ("4", "ua2"):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [VERAPDF_BIN, "-f", flavour, str(path)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        assert result.returncode == 0
